  Mnemonic: CppCompile
  Target: //lto:bin
  Configuration: k8-fastbuild
  Execution platform: @platforms//host:host
  ActionKey: 48db0fe11e2329d685a78d684c7076d83d210b8354bdd82b4d6d4b03734fde80
  Inputs: [lto/lib.h, lto/main.c]
  Outputs: [bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.d, bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.indexing.o, bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.o]
  Environment: [PATH=/bin:/usr/bin:/usr/local/bin]
  Command Line: (exec /usr/bin/gcc \
    -MD \
    -MF \
    bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.d \
    '-frandom-seed=bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.o' \
    -fPIC \
    -iquote \
    . \
    -iquote \
    bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin \
    -iquote \
    external/rules_cc+ \
    -iquote \
    bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/external/rules_cc+ \
    -iquote \
    external/bazel_tools \
    -iquote \
    bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/external/bazel_tools \
    '-flto=thin' \
    'lto_indexing_bitcode=bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.indexing.o' \
    -c \
    lto/main.c \
    -o \
    bazel-out/k8-fastbuild/bin/lto/_objs/bin/main.pic.o)
